text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigerian Foreign Minister Tom Ikimi expected in Morocco on a two-day visit on Feb 24.
- Moroccan centre for judiciary studies organises seminar on ways to get closer to the European legislation on issues of common interest.
- Court cuts jail term to six years on pharmacist sentenced initially to nine years imprisonment for importing contaminated blood products.
- Jordan's King Hussein leaves Rabat after two-day visit during which he discussed with King Hassan the peace process in the Middle East.
- Moroccan banks to reduce interest rates by one percentage point for long term investment loans.
- Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc is to expand after it bought 80 percent of soft drinks company Societe Industrielle Marocaine.
